name: NBA Price Gap
pitch: Doesn't try to pick the winner. It treats Pinnacle as the best read on each team's chance, and flags when an Australian book is still offering a better price, usually on the underdog.
about: This desk does not pick winners. It treats Pinnacle as the sharpest price, turns that into a fair chance with proportional de-vig — (1/price) ÷ (1/home + 1/away) — and alerts when the best Australian price times that chance is at least 1.03. NBA moneylines only, back bets only (no lays, no spreads). Books: Sportsbet, Ladbrokes, Neds, TAB, PointsBet, Unibet, and Betfair AU. Betfair is scored after 8% commission: 1 + (price − 1) × 0.92. Flat 1 unit at the alerted price. A favourite is a fair chance of 50% or more; the rest are underdogs.
source: External NBA price-gap scanner (not this repo). Empty until that pipeline publishes alerts.
notes: Record starts 7 Nov 2026. Flat 1 unit at the alerted price. Own snapshot only — never mixed with John, Closing Line Sniper, ProbaLab, EdgeBot, or NFL Totals. No Telegram in this repo.
isolation: Own snapshot id=nba-price-gap only. Never mixed with john (latest), sniper, probalab, edgebot, or nfl-weather.

meta.name: NBA Price Gap
meta.pitch: Doesn't try to pick the winner. It treats Pinnacle as the best read on each team's chance, and flags when an Australian book is still offering a better price, usually on the underdog.

method.markets: NBA moneyline back bets only. No lays, no spreads, no totals.
method.fair_chance: Pinnacle fair chance for the side backed = (1/price) / (1/home + 1/away), proportional de-vig of the two Pinnacle moneylines.
method.alert: Alert when best Australian price × Pinnacle fair chance >= 1.03.
method.gap_pct: Stored as a fraction: alerted price × pinnacle_fair − 1. 0.03 means +3%.
method.betfair_au: Use the net price after 8% commission: 1 + (price - 1) * 0.92. Store that net price as price and price_taken.
method.stake: Flat 1 unit at the alerted price.
method.roles: favourite when pinnacle_fair >= 0.5, otherwise underdog. Tag them separately.
method.vs_close: Fraction (alerted price / Pinnacle close) − 1. Null until the close is known. Positive means the alerted price beat the close.
method.scanner: Out of scope for this repo. A separate pipeline fills open_bets and results.

row_schema.selection: same as side — required for the desk to show the row
row_schema.book: sportsbet | ladbrokes | neds | tab | pointsbet | unibet | betfair_au
row_schema.price: decimal odds at alert; Betfair already net of 8% commission
row_schema.vs_close: fraction vs Pinnacle close, or null while open
row_schema.pnl_units: null while open; net units once settled
